description: 4D Molecular Therapeutics have engineered more than 1 billion viral vectors (carriers of targeted gene therapies) which can be optimized and customized to target both rare and large market diseases affecting any tissue or cell type in the body. Their extensive collection of intellectual property is coupled with expanding capabilities in cGMP manufacturing. Both in vivo (in human) and ex vivo (external to humans such as cell cultures) capabilities exist.
At the heart of 908 systems are molecular traps a thousand times smaller than those in conventional mass spectrometers.

A2 Biotherapeutics identifies the differences that distinguish tumor cells from normal cells and then targets them by mimicking the natural, selective and cellular killing activities of our immune system. They engineer T cells that are optimized for identifying tumor cells with high accuracy which results in selectively killing the targets versus compromising healthy cells. Their platform targets solid tumors of many forms via the combination of activators/blockers.

AbSci represents the future biopharmaceuticals. This startup is based in Vancouver, WA and leverages advanced metabolic strain laboratory culture and bioprocessing and purification methods. The result is highly efficient and cost-effective development of pharmaceutical therapies.
Adaptive is translating the brilliance of the adaptive immune system with a powerful platform.

Affinia is leveraging its proprietary platform for rationally designed novel, second-generation AAV vectors and therapies. Affinia is building a gene therapy company to broaden the reach of gene therapies by leveraging a discovery platform to engineer novel AAV vectors that overcome the limitations of conventional approaches. Addressing the field’s challenges, from tissue selectivity and immunogenicity, to manufacturing yields, and payload capacity, Affinia AAV vectors and gene constructs broaden the reach of gene therapies to meaningful numbers of patients.

Alector is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering immuno-neurology, a novel therapeutic approach for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. Immuno-neurology targets immune dysfunction as a root cause of multiple pathologies that are drivers of degenerative brain disorders. The Company’s product candidates are supported by biomarkers and target genetically defined patient populations in frontotemporal dementia and Alzheimer’s disease.

The founding principle of Aledade stems from thousands of conversations with stakeholders from across the country: primary care providers are the foundation of an efficient and effective health care system.

AmplifyBio combines the strength and experience of multi-disciplinary teams to advance translational science, cell and gene therapies and next-generation medicines by offering pre-clinical models and support services to support customers in finding success through fast, efficient and safe drug development. The experienced team will work to create and optimize new platforms and technologies, focus on enabling the research, development and production of next-generation therapies and work at solving the challenges of scaling complex therapies.
